mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.13% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 235 indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5.0% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000, it indicates a tight labor market and strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market and strong demand
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0 and HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle, defined by FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL above 235, leads to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 235.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 indicate strong residential demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: The current industrial production (INDPRO=105.7) is above the 2017 base of 100, indicating robust supply conditions that support economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the unemployment rate is below 5.0%, it indicates an accommodative monetary policy and a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy and tight labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 and UNRATE <= 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Residential fixed investment (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars indicates strong housing market activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 400000.
